skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze core issues in development economics, including demographic trends, financial policies, agricultural and industrial development, and international trade strategies.
Analyze and formulate policies related to development economics, including population policies, financial policies, and sector-specific policies.
Work effectively in groups, contributing to discussions and presentations on development economics topics.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and propose solutions to development challenges.
Foster a habit of self-learning and independent study in the field of development economics.
Improve skills in reading, writing, and presenting development economics topics.
Analyze data and reports to support arguments and conclusions in development economics.
Conduct research and gather data to support development economics studies.
